summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that automatically fires on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from a pinned GitHub release URL, then uses that runtime to execute a locally-shipped 727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js` at the package root. math_init.js is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) containing a ~1000-entry mixed-hex string array and a runtime rotate/shuffle string-array deobfuscator (`WV8StW(arr,n)`), with `_0xNNNN`-style identifier obfuscation also present in setup.mjs itself. The package's stated purpose is a chatbot API client (NSwag-generated TypeScript), which does not require a Bun-compiled obfuscated binary blob to install or run. Executing an opaque payload through an alternate runtime at install time bypasses Node-based tooling and inspection; the shape matches an alternate-runtime dropper rather than a legitimate native-build step, and a further static match on network + `ping` primitives inside dist/api-client/titan-chat/native-client.js is consistent with additional install/runtime-side network behavior in shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
